concerns.text: Plan permits a synthetic BMG dataset fallback, but tasks T016 and T048 explicitly forbid any fallback and raise a ValueError on API failure. This directly contradicts the synthetic‑fallback policy in the plan and weakens FR‑001 (data download) while violating the constitution’s reproducibility principle.

The implementation plan states that Bayes Factors will be used as a fallback for model comparison, yet no task implements this (T027 only covers Wilcoxon and corrected t‑test). This omits a required comparison method, weakening FR‑007.
Success Criterion SC‑002 requires measuring MAE improvement over the linear‑regression baseline, but no task explicitly computes or records this improvement. The criterion is effectively dropped.

Task T003 promises linting/formatting configuration files (.ruff.toml, .flake8, pyproject.toml) and a lint script, yet the task description provides no artifact paths or verification steps that would produce these files. The deliverable is missing, making the task unverifiable.

FR‑001 expects the system to download BMG data; however, the tasks enforce a fatal error on missing API data instead of providing a runnable fallback, contradicting the spec’s implicit requirement for a functional pipeline when external data is unavailable.
